reason_for_separate_host: The original macOS eight-endpoint one-second-deadline cell failed under observed shared-host load/swap pressure. Its failed rows remain unchanged; macOS32/interference were not run to protect resources. Linux is a separate native-process qualification, not a fix or replacement for the macOS result.
source_continuity: All nine adapter/probe source and fixture hashes equal the original d53cb335 measurement-source.sha256. Later source commit adds distinct live harness/documentation, not this probe.
authorization: Existing user-approved Wick test host, separate task directory/processes; no change to other labs or DeepSeek services, no new guest or VM disk allocation.

host.isolation: One owned benchmark cell at a time; wait for owned native/coverage workloads to finish before execution. Other user services remain active and untouched.

build.target: Reuse existing shared host target; copy one small private executable so later coverage instrumentation cannot replace the measured binary. Record its SHA-256 before each run.

unchanged_profiles.quota_profile: Original native-tier totals and control reservation; unchanged. No new deadline/limit/pipeline negotiation.

evidence_contract.source_binary_host: Record exact source, binary SHA256, toolchain, CPU/memory/load, observed UTC timestamps and every actual process exit code.
evidence_contract.byte_cpu_latency: Actual canonical encrypted envelopes plus framing in both directions; aggregate process CPU once plus per-worker ThreadTime, setup separate. CPU includes recorder snapshots/checkpoints/teardown. Never add CPU to elapsed or infer send-only/energy. TCP/IP headers and retransmission excluded.
evidence_contract.memory: Fresh process per cell and getrusage kernel lifetime RSS high-water. Sampling and tracker snapshots do not prove arbitrary tenant-churn reclamation.
evidence_contract.gates: The original CLI pass/fail checks apply unchanged: exact readbacks and counters, scheduled healthy completions, zero unexpected errors, explicit hot quota refusal if observed, no resource ceiling breach. Retain all failures and incomplete admissions.
evidence_contract.scope: Native Linux process and TCP loopback logical endpoint concurrency. Not booted MVM population, real or shaped WAN, Windows gateway, complete MVM acceptance or statistical speedup evidence.
evidence_contract.storage: Compact JSONL/identity records only; no persistent payload dataset, new VM disks, or local duplicate build tree. Copy compact records to Git after execution; remove only owned disposable artifacts after verification.
